entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer supporting multi-level states for Users, Sessions, and Agents. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval and is available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It provides automated fact extraction, context fencing, and connectors for services like Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that uses the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing. It implements tiered L0/L1/L2 data loading and provides observable retrieval via directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This brain for the Hermes Agent provides synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without requiring LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system supports long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents. It provides an LLM wrapper for existing agents and is accessible via Python and Node.js client SDKs.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a markdown context tree using git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system with sub-100ms latency and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that utilizes a single SQLite database. It supports direct memory operations via a Python SDK and supports MCP via stdio or SSE.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure of Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation and simulation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite-backed message store with FTS metadata. It builds depth-aware summary nodes in a hierarchical DAG to ensure messages are never lost.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer utilizes an open engram YAML format to store plain-text data for multi-agent systems. It provides local-first, zero-cost search capabilities and is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, and Cursor.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI offers a local-first identity and secrets layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients. It maintains local custody of SQLite and workspace files, achieving an average of 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that uses hybrid retrieval methods, including BM25, vector search, and graph traversal. It automates decision capture via a local GGUF observer model and integrates directly through Hermes plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes context for Hermes Agent through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% of tokens during LLM inference.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter. The architecture relies on SQLite with FTS5 search rather than vector databases or embeddings.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled result. It supports temporal context graphs with recency-aware ranking and allows for mounting signed expertise files via knowledge packs.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It utilizes SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server for automated configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack serves as a memory kernel stack for Hermes by integrating Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver evidence packets for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes and supports automated indexing for codebases and multimedia.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by using local BM25 ranking for keyword-based tool selection. It includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, potentially reducing prompt tokens by 94%. It renders these facts into markdown files and offers persistent, encrypted memory storage through Perseus Vault.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn enables long-term, cross-project memory by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores data as inspectable Markdown files and utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for coding agents.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin stores data in a single .lbdb embedded graph database file and utilizes importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories. It differentiates itself by combining BM25 keyword search with named graph relationships and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking every memory operation. It is designed for users requiring immediate event deletion to ensure removed data does not persist in future recall.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo provides durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox, offering tools to search, update, and remember state.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It allows agents to autonomously pay for services or charge for their own API usage with just a few lines of code.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide agents with self-organizing long-term memory. It includes specialized tools for manual memory storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve retrieval accuracy.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: Focusing on security and performance, this provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports both native Rust FFI and HTTP daemon modes. It utilizes HNSW, sparse, and FM-index indexing alongside MinHash deduplication for robust data management.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local capabilities such as scripts, markdown documents, and MCP servers to facilitate efficient routing. It provides five native tools for searching and reporting on artifacts, including an opt-in feature for automatic tool-OKF generation.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: Penfield offers a suite of 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It uniquely features automatic context checkpointing during message compression to maintain continuity.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This provider serves as a private local code memory for repositories, supporting both semantic and literal code searches. It enables grounded Q&A by providing specific file-and-line citations directly from the local codebase.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework introduces a subagent-driven methodology for software development through a library of composable skills. It integrates a dedicated brainstorming and design refinement phase to ensure structured task execution.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to handle design and prototyping tasks via a dedicated CLI. It supports automated exports to HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 formats while maintaining compatibility with various coding agents.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from ingested data. It supports Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients to maintain context across multiple sessions.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository offers 817 structured cybersecurity skills across 29 domains, mapped to industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. These skills are compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance security-focused agent capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions using 11 diagram type presets. It features self-check and auto-fix capabilities to convert Mermaid text into visual diagrams accurately.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: Designed for Hermes and other agents, this tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns. It utilizes a two-pass detection process and a 112-entry word replacement table to refine output quality.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution by automating deduplication and quality improvements across shared user teams. It unifies skill libraries across multiple agents and devices to ensure consistent performance upgrades.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 12 metaskills designed to guide agents through complex business and code journeys. It is compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents, supporting installation via the Claude Code Plugin Marketplace.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce by providing adjudication, escrow, and dispute resolution services. It utilizes natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions to facilitate secure autonomous transactions.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: A collection of 832 professional skills formatted as plain markdown files that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It provides ready-to-paste exports for other assistants including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds to streamline the creation of new agent capabilities.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This tool enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches and extract transcripts, captions, and timestamps without relying on yt-dlp. It also supports channel browsing and playlist extraction for comprehensive YouTube data access.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom analytical instructions and thinking prompts tailored to specific domains. It enhances output quality by reporting findings alongside a dedicated analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It utilizes progressive disclosure and remote registries to maintain prompt efficiency while supporting programmatic skill management.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills automate the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. The workflow includes Lite and Full complexity modes and features a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler for extracting runnable code and automatically syncs source file edits back to the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro provides a harness for long-running agents using a three-level work model and structured memory backed by files or SQLite. It facilitates cross-feature learning and task management through a dedicated CLI and plan-approve-execute cycles.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin implements cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded agent work.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These interoperable skills allow agents to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts via CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. The project follows the Agent Skills specification and includes specialized services for CRE and ACE environments.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides standardized prompting guidelines and API integration patterns for the FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 image generation models. It supports precise hex color specifications and structured JSON prompting with built-in error handling and webhook support.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories and documentation URLs into version-pinned, compliant instruction files for AI agents. It ensures transparency by providing provenance through file:line citations or direct source URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io serves as a registry for reusable AI skills, offering a Python client and CLI for installation. It manages recursive dependency resolution and incorporates commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks through autonomous execution and real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety by providing built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for task recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client uses a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It utilizes a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata retrieval.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language for AI that utilizes a four-verb specification to define intents as code. It enhances agent reliability by providing static auditing via 'nika check' and generating tamper-evident, hash-chained execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle Eye provides a five-layer retrieval system for Hermes Agent that combines hard triggers, FTS5, and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists. This approach reduces token usage during LLM calls and features graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across multiple interfaces like Discord and Telegram by tailoring rewrites to specific model families and reasoning capabilities. It tracks quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database while preserving non-English prompts through language detection heuristics.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: HermaGuard performs adversarial code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It integrates deterministic pre-scans from tools like Semgrep and Bandit, using a feedback MCP server to generate suppression rules for false positives.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements a systematic investigation protocol for Hermes Agent, utilizing multi-story task decomposition and mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors during causal debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io standard integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports the automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files to facilitate progressive disclosure of agent capabilities.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub serves as a community platform for browsing and installing skills, fully implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a three-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness. It employs a risk-tiered triage system to categorize modifications and detects language-specific anti-patterns such as N+1 queries.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This project provides a localized ecosystem for Portuguese-speaking users, offering guides, RAG skills, and B2B prospecting tools. All contributions follow the agentskills.io format to ensure compatibility with the broader Hermes Agent framework.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides direct installation commands for discovered plugins and is compatible with clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard, Hermes Agent, and OpenClaw environments.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate structured Chinese news reports across multiple geographic scales, ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search expansions with user interests and incorporates quality gates to produce briefings complete with core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: Provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: Offers scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. The repository includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and guides for hardware and UI access using Termux:API and Termux:GUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: Provides an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: An unofficial community Helm chart for deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports both direct deployment and operator-ready CRD-based workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: A one-command installer that enables the Hermes AI assistant on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through Termux cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Sandboxes Hermes Agent using hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. This setup provides kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access and allows for configurable security policies regarding web search and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: A simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: A Nix package and NixOS module designed for reproducible Hermes deployment. It features declarative configuration for workspace documents and cli-config.yaml, alongside hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: A self-hosted control plane used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: A Docker-first control plane for orchestrating multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities, supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and offers enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: A production-ready, headless systemd deployment for Ubuntu and Debian servers. It configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service to enable the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM-based analysts, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical roles, to perform financial trading. It incorporates risk and portfolio management and supports local Ollama models alongside various LLM providers.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform manages multi-agent workflows and monitors spend across frameworks like CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen. It provides a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API for task tracking and scheduling.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI, web dashboard, and CLI to manage diverse coding agents such as Claude Code and Gemini. It offers optional sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This framework employs a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegating tasks between orchestrators and specialists. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management using Hermes Agent profiles. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack via parallel model querying and synthesis for local execution. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling and is optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that pre-indexes projects to reduce token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It supports automatic synchronization across Windows, macOS, and Linux to maintain an updated context for the agent.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI tool and visualization dashboard designed to track token usage and associated costs across multiple AI coding agents. It monitors activity from clients such as Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Gemini to provide clear spending oversight.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect real API traffic and agent context from tools like Hermes Agent and Cursor. Users can compare adjacent requests to identify changes and export traces into self-contained HTML files for easier review.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading agent states directly from CLIs. It features multi-device synchronization and historical usage trends to help manage session details and account limits.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and loads 36 skills for building and operating applications. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments to streamline agent operations.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project enables customization of the Hermes terminal UI through YAML-based themes and community-driven skins. Users can modify ASCII art banners, spinners, and colors to achieve aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy platform that provides autonomous agents with human-readable @handles and encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills to run directly within the Claude Code Channel without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control that includes a supervisor sidebar for managing sessions and checkpoints. It provides a dedicated dev tools panel for inspecting MCP activity and supports providers like Anthropic and OpenAI.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This repository provides integrations for frameworks such as CrewAI and LangGraph, alongside memory applications for Slack and VS Code. It includes a specific plugin for Claude Code to capture prompts and tool traces.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and DevOps, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local skills. It allows developers to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining localized memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation of a hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories, enabling a production-ready setup with free models at zero cost.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that analyzes AI agent configurations and system prompts across JSON, YAML, Markdown, and Python files. It provides deterministic local checks to detect issues such as unbounded retries or vague instructions using HERM v1.1 scoring.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md files, skills, and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and maps complex nested authentication structures for the new environment.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform offers passive monitoring and active probing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It features a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes configuration-aware baselines by watching local files.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing multiple agentic tools, including Hermes Agent.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: An open-source cowork application that supports various agent CLIs like Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It features built-in assistants for Word, Excel, and PPT, and offers remote access via WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram and WeChat.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface designed for using Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile phones. It provides a three-panel layout featuring chat and workspace file browsing with full parity to the Hermes CLI.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing and configuring Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing chat, sessions, and tools across multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard available via desktop, npm CLI, or Docker that manages sessions, scheduled jobs, and usage analytics. It supports 10 platform channels, including Discord and Slack, and includes visual workflow building and Kanban task tracking.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It utilizes tmux-backed workers for Swarm Mode and includes a Monaco-based file browser.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and other agents. It supports sub-agent delegation and provides native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair, alongside views for Kanban, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, Rust, and TypeScript. It supports Windows and macOS and includes the Hermes-CN-Core runtime.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium that connects active browser contexts to Hermes Agent runtimes. It supports local, cloud, or remote gateways and includes Hermes Web for full-page workspace sessions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from a phone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to manage tasks, skills, workspace files, and real-time streaming chat.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It features a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, alongside a live workspace for monitoring diffs and code writes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS application that serves as a session browser and agent cockpit. It provides searchable history for multiple coding-agent CLIs and tracks live per-session quota burn with local-only data processing.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management alongside tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for managing requests that involve side effects.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable desktop version of Hermes Agent for Windows that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports connections to local and cloud AI models and includes a dynamic tool maker.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted AI assistance. It provides real-time log streaming, a file browser, and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A configuration and process monitoring dashboard for Hermes. It allows for real-time tracking of session activity and costs, as well as read-only inspection of environment variables and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, alongside isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
